title: Analysis and figure code for "Hidden motor neuron activity restores grasp in children with paralysed hand"
description:
Analysis and figure-generation code accompanying the study Hidden motor neuron activity restores grasp in children with paralysed hand. Includes the high-density surface-EMG figure scripts (Figure 2, Figure 3) and the Figure 4 offline-decoding pipeline (rule-based attempt labelling, leave-one-repetition-out CatBoost cross-validation, permutation statistics, Figure 4, Supplementary Figures S2b–S7b and Supplementary Table S2).

Data note: the EMG recordings were acquired from children with hand paralysis after early brain lesions, including two children after hemispherotomy. To protect this vulnerable participant group, no participant data — neither the raw recordings nor any derived features — are distributed with this software. All data are available from the authors on reasonable request. This archive contains the analysis and figure code only, provided so that the methodology is fully transparent and the results can be reproduced once data access has been granted.
